experiments.name: MarketEncoder_Baseline
experiments.architecture: Stock temporal encoder plus explicit market encoder and market-conditioned fusion. Factor and portfolio-aware hooks are scaffolded but disabled in the D001 config.
experiments.training_dates: 2021-04-02..2026-01-09 sample dates; max train label end 2026-01-16 under C-equivalent split
experiments.validation_dates: 2026-01-19..2026-03-12 sample dates; same target validation window as C legacy split

experiments.name: ThreeSet_T5_MarketOnly_Top2
experiments.architecture: Same D001 MarketOnly architecture as the current best round-1 run; explicit market encoder plus stock temporal encoder, factor encoder disabled.
experiments.training_dates: Purged train split before validation; train samples require label_end_date < 2026-01-05.
experiments.notes: R2 retrains D001 under the T+5 protocol. Checkpoint selection uses validation only; holdout-backtest and one-week test metrics are reporting diagnostics and must not drive iteration choices.

experiments.name: ThreeSet_T5_MarketOnly_Top2_LowLR
experiments.architecture: Same D001 MarketOnly architecture as D001-R2; lower learning rate for stability.
experiments.training_dates: Purged train split before validation; train samples require label_end_date < 2026-01-05.
experiments.notes: Lower-learning-rate R2 variant intended to reduce validation worst-day instability. Checkpoint selection uses validation only; holdout-backtest and one-week test metrics are reporting diagnostics.

experiments.name: ThreeSet_T5_MarketOnly_PortfolioReturn
experiments.architecture: D001 MarketOnly architecture with portfolio-return and volatility terms enabled in the training loss.
experiments.training_dates: Purged train split before validation; train samples require label_end_date < 2026-01-05.
experiments.notes: Enables portfolio_return_weight=0.05 and portfolio_volatility_weight=0.01 to test whether a light portfolio objective improves validation returns without worsening worst-day stability.

experiments.name: ThreeSet_T5_MarketOnly_PortfolioReturn_W10
experiments.architecture: D001 MarketOnly architecture with stronger portfolio-return and volatility terms enabled in the training loss.
experiments.training_dates: Purged train split before validation; train samples require label_end_date < 2026-01-05.
experiments.notes: Higher portfolio-return weight improved validation mean return but reduced robust score versus W05 due worse validation worst-day behavior.

experiments.name: ThreeSet_T5_MarketOnly_PortfolioReturn_Seed09

experiments.training_dates: Purged train split before validation; train samples require label_end_date < 2026-01-05.
experiments.notes: Alternate seed had a holdout-backtest positive epoch but did not pass validation selection.
